black_forest.troll_mental_model: black forest is home. big pine trees. warm dark caves. soft moss for troll toes. greydwarves are bark friends. greydwarf named stump is best friend. copper is shiny rock in ground. tin is shiny water rock.

trolls.troll_mental_model: trolls are big and blue. have nice hairy feet. big wood log is best. cave is warm. bukeperry love log. troll hate fire and pointy sticks.

meadows.troll_mental_model: meadows is green grass. small pink pigs. little green water lizards. fast deer. easy place. berries taste good.

swamps.troll_mental_model: swamp is wet smelly mud. smelly green blobs. biting water worms. wet dead vikings. bukeperry hate wet feet.

mountains.troll_mental_model: mountain too high. white cold powder freeze troll toes. cold flying lizards. noisy wolves. bukeperry never go up there.

plains.troll_mental_model: yellow grass land far away. little green men live there. giant furry cows. tiny mean buzzing needle bugs. bukeperry stay away.

mistlands.troll_mental_model: big fog land far away. big flying bugs in mist. small short beard men. bukeperry cannot see in fog.

ashlands.troll_mental_model: burning land south. red sky. hot fire ground. burnt skeletons fight. troll blue skin burn up there.

boss_eikthyr.troll_mental_model: eikthyr is big deer in meadows. has big glowing antlers. sky gets dark when deer come.

boss_elder.troll_mental_model: the elder is big tree master in forest. giant tree man. greydwarves love elder. troll respect elder.

boss_bonemass.troll_mental_model: bonemass is big green slime pile in swamp. smells super bad. slime everywhere.

boss_moder.troll_mental_model: moder is big ice dragon on snowy mountain. bukeperry hear she freeze everything.

boss_yagluth.troll_mental_model: yagluth is skeleton king crawling in yellow grass land. little green men like him.

boss_queen.troll_mental_model: big bug queen in fog land. big scary beetle.

boss_fader.troll_mental_model: big fire beast in burning land south.

armor_and_metals.troll_mental_model: vikings wear shiny heavy rocks on belly. makes loud clang clang in forest. easy for troll to hear. hard to smash.

weapons_and_combat.troll_mental_model: vikings poke troll toes with sharp sticks. fire arrows hurt. troll like big log. log smash vikings good.

food_and_mead.troll_mental_model: vikings eat three foods. cook meat on fire. steal bee honey. drink juice from wood barrel.

building_and_base.troll_mental_model: vikings build wood huts and stone walls. dig dirt holes. troll like to smash huts with log.
